{"metadata":{"description":"Interactive terminal agent (fork of DeepSeek Harness): Claude Code-style REPL — full-screen UI, markdown rendering, session stats, permission cycling, custom OpenAI-compatible providers.","id":"gh:1333689681","install_available":false,"language":"TypeScript","name":"deepseek-harness-cli","slug":"soolaugust/deepseek-harness-cli","topics":["deepseek","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Interactive terminal agent (fork of DeepSeek Harness): Claude Code-style REPL — full-screen UI, mark"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"down rendering, session stats, permission cycling, custom OpenAI-compatible providers."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh cli — interactive terminal agent"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"`dsh cli` is an **interactive terminal agent**, forked from DeepSeek Harness with a CLI focus: a Cla"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"ude Code-style coding experience in your terminal — full-screen UI, streaming output, tool cards, se"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"ssion history, and permission controls, with no browser needed."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Under the hood it is DeepSeek Harness's plugin architecture (everything is a plugin), but this repos"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"itory only cares about and polishes the single `dsh cli` interaction path."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **Claude Code-style interaction**: full-screen alternate screen, input bar pinned to the bottom, u"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"p/down arrow history navigation (including cross-session persistent history)
- **Markdown terminal r"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"endering**: bold, italic, code, lists, and headings rendered with terminal styles
- **Tool card fold"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"ing**: adjacent tool calls merge into one line, expand with `Ctrl+O`
- **Session stats bar**: turns/"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"steps, LLM time, first-token latency, throughput, cache hit rate, input/output tokens
- **Permission"},{"id":"p7s6","text":" badge**: `Shift+Tab` cycles `read-only → workspace-write → danger-full-access`, with `danger-full-a"},{"id":"p7s7","text":"ccess` shown as "bypass permissions"
- **Custom provider**: point to any OpenAI-compatible endpoint "},{"id":"p7s8","text":"(e.g. mify), with both model routing and `web_search` configurable
- **Session resume**: reopening `"},{"id":"p7s9","text":"dsh cli` continues the last session, switch with `/session`
- **Hot-reload development**: `pnpm dsh:"},{"id":"p7s10","text":"dev` (node --watch) auto-restarts on source changes"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Demo"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Quick start"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Requires Node.js ≥ 22."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"From npm:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"The first launch creates/resumes a session; type text and press Enter to send, and model output rend"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"ers streaming above the input bar."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"| Action | Effect |"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"| Type text + `Enter` | Send to the agent |
| `↑` / `↓` | History navigation (cross-session persiste"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"nt) |
| `Shift+Tab` | Cycle permission preset |
| `Ctrl+O` | Expand/collapse tool group |
| `Ctrl+C`"},{"id":"p17s3","text":" | Cancel current turn while running; quit at the prompt |
| `/exit` `/help` `/clear` `/session` `/m"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"odel` `/permission` | Slash commands |"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Full instructions in the CLI guide."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Configuring a custom provider"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Point `~/.dsh/settings.yaml` at any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (e.g. mify, OpenRouter); both model r"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"outing and `web_search` are configurable. See CLI guide · Using a custom model provider."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Inherited from DeepSeek Harness"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"This repository is a fork of DeepSeek Harness focused on its `dsh cli` interactive terminal capabili"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"ty.
